preamble:
-- Preamble: lean/Verified.lean Parts A to I plus the Part J definitions (planeOf, cand, plaqsOf), without the Part J lemmas.
-- Note: extra_tactics were written by the proposer; for planeOf_lt, planeOf_gt, and card_bd the hint was essentially the proof.

targets.name: planeOf_lt
targets.statement: theorem planeOf_lt {d N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (α β : Fin d) (h : α < β) : (planeOf α β : Option {q : Fin d × Fin d // q.1 < q.2}) = some ⟨(α, β), h⟩
targets.proof:
theorem planeOf_lt {d N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (α β : Fin d) (h : α < β) : (planeOf α β : Option {q : Fin d × Fin d // q.1 < q.2}) = some ⟨(α, β), h⟩ := by
  simp [planeOf, h]

targets.name: planeOf_gt
targets.statement: theorem planeOf_gt {d N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (α β : Fin d) (h : β < α) : (planeOf α β : Option {q : Fin d × Fin d // q.1 < q.2}) = some ⟨(β, α), h⟩
targets.proof:
theorem planeOf_gt {d N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (α β : Fin d) (h : β < α) : (planeOf α β : Option {q : Fin d × Fin d // q.1 < q.2}) = some ⟨(β, α), h⟩ := by
  simp [planeOf, h, not_lt.mpr h.le]

targets.name: card_bd
targets.about: a plaquette has at most four boundary links
targets.statement: theorem card_bd {d N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (q : Plaq d N) : (bd q).card ≤ 4
targets.proof:
theorem card_bd {d N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (q : Plaq d N) : (bd q).card ≤ 4 := by
  exact Finset.card_le_four

targets.name: mem_bd_cand
targets.about: every plaquette containing l is a candidate
targets.statement: theorem mem_bd_cand {d N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (l : Link d N) (q : Plaq d N) (hl : l ∈ bd q) : ∃ c, cand l c = some q
targets.stuck_goal:
d N : ℕ
inst✝ : NeZero N
l : Link d N
q : Plaq d N
hl : l ∈ bd q
⊢ ∃ c, cand l c = some q

targets.name: card_plaqsOf
targets.about: a link lies in at most 2d plaquettes
targets.statement: theorem card_plaqsOf {d N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (l : Link d N) : (plaqsOf l).card ≤ 2 * d
targets.stuck_goal:
d N : ℕ
inst✝ : NeZero N
l : Link d N
⊢ (plaqsOf l).card ≤ 2 * d

targets.name: degree_bound
targets.about: each plaquette shares a link with at most 8d plaquettes
targets.statement: theorem degree_bound {d N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (q : Plaq d N) : (Animals.nbr (HTE.share (@bd d N _)) q).card ≤ 8 * d
